enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Animal Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt the natural, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Animals.
Vermin Bane 6: This weapon is ideal for cleaning out rats and other annoying beasts. It deals an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Vermin.
Reptilian Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt those with cunning and scales, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Reptilians.
Humanoid Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to those that walk among us, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Humanoids.
Doublestrike 15%: Passive: 15% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Seeker +14: Provides a +14 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +14 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
